items.title: Cohomology on a presheaf of sets agrees for a module and its underlying abelian sheaf

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the cohomology of a module on a presheaf of sets agrees with the cohomology of its underlying abelian sheaf (statement lines 2052-2059). The proof reduces the first group to the underlying abelian sheaf, since the topos attached to the presheaf of sets sees only the abelian structure (proof lines 2061-2066), and then applies the companion comparison between the cohomology of a module and of its underlying abelian sheaf (proof lines 2066-2070). The non-formal content is the reduction to the abelian case. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one companion result.
